# Weyland-Yutani Corporate Security Handbook ## Site Security Edition
[color=#a4885c]Weyland-Yutani Corporation. Corporate Security personnel only. This handbook may not be shown to other Company staff, and may never be shown to anyone outside the Company.[/color]
These are the regulations and procedures for Corporate Security and Personal Protection at colonial sites. They apply in addition to the Employee Handbook. Where the two disagree, this handbook takes precedence.
Security exists to protect the Company's people, property and research, and its reputation above all three. Officers are expected to judge every situation by one question: how much would this cost the Company if it got out?
Failure to follow these procedures is recorded in the officer's personnel file. Failures that expose the Company end the officer's contract, and the Company decides the terms.
[italic]Building Better Worlds.[/italic]
